fact: The FSCA's 2025 Regulation Plan says that, with the SARB National Payment System Department's draft Directive X of 2025 (14 March 2025) proposing a payment-provider authorisation framework, the FSCA will in the coming year develop a draft Conduct Standard applicable to payment services activities, timed with the NPSD.
system: FSCA Conduct Standard on payment services (planned)
